about: Atlanta skyline towers made in Blender. Units are real metres (glTF +Y up). Origin is the centre of the footprint at ground level. Each file has one daytime mesh plus a *-glow mesh meant to be emissive at night (warm white or orange). Vertex colours, no textures. Real-world positions are offsets from Five Points (33.7545, -84.3898) with x = east and n = north; in the scene use z = -n. Apply the city's own map projection and building scales; the research note research/metro/03-atlanta-map-and-assets.md section 1.7 suggests a 0.30 map scale with 0.40 footprint and 0.45 height scales.

towers.name: Bank of America Plaza
towers.rotationNote: The tower is set at 45 degrees to the street grid; rotate it 45 degrees relative to the surrounding blocks.

towers.name: Truist Plaza
towers.rotationNote: Faces align with the street grid.

towers.name: Westin Peachtree Plaza
towers.rotationNote: Cylinder; the scenic elevator tube is on the +x side and should face Peachtree Street.

towers.name: 191 Peachtree Tower
towers.rotationNote: The two shafts are linked along local y; the long side faces Peachtree Street.

towers.name: One Atlantic Center
towers.rotationNote: Faces align with the street grid; visible across Piedmont Park from the east.
